Compression set is the whole game

An O-ring seals by being squeezed and springing back. We test compression set in-house to ASTM D395 Method B and report it with every consignment — it is the number that says whether the seal is still a seal in a year.
Class A size codes are the same as AS568 dash numbers. Send either — or the groove dimensions to ISO 3601-2 and we will size the ring to the housing.
A good ring in a bad groove still leaks
Squeeze too light and it weeps; too heavy and it takes a set. If you are designing the housing, send it to us before you cut it — the check costs nothing and it is where most seal failures start.

What is the minimum order quantity for this part?

We supply in bulk. The minimum run is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound, or quoted against the part where geometry or tooling makes that unrealistic. Prototype and first-article lots sit outside the minimum.
Can you match a competitor specification or reverse-engineer an existing part?

Yes. Send the size code if you have one — that is the whole specification. If not, send the old ring, and tell us the medium and temperature: a used O-ring has taken a set and measures smaller than it was moulded, so we size from the groove, not the sample.
What file formats do you accept for drawings?

PDF, DWG and DXF — but for an O-ring a drawing is usually unnecessary. An ISO 3601 designation or AS568 dash number, plus the compound and hardness, is a complete specification. Groove dimensions to ISO 3601-2 if you have them.
Do you provide material test reports with each shipment?

Yes. Material test reports, dimensional inspection sheets and a certificate of conformance ship with every consignment. Hardness, tensile to ASTM D412 and compression set to ASTM D395 Method B are tested in-house, with dimensions and surface quality checked to ISO 3601-1 and -3.
What are your payment and delivery terms for international orders?

TT and LC accepted, discussed per order. Ex-works Nashik or FOB Nhava Sheva. Commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin are issued with every consignment. O-rings ship bagged and labelled by size code.
